AWS Accounts (8 total):
  - AcmeDev (111222333444) — staging environment for Acme
  - AcmeProd (222333444555) — production for Acme
  - AcmeTest (333444555666) — test environment
  - GlobexDev (444555666777) — staging for Globex
  - GlobexProd (555666777888) — production for Globex
  - GlobexSecurity (666777888999) — security hub, GuardDuty org admin
  - Management (777888999000) — AWS Organizations management account

  GCP Projects:
  - acme-staging and acme-production — the only two with active GCP
  workloads

  VPC Layout:
  - VPCs spread across 16+ AWS regions per account (all standard
  regions)
  - Primary workload regions: eu-central-1 and us-east-1
  - GlobexProd also uses eu-west-1 for services
  - VPC Flow Logs enforced on all VPCs — some managed externally
  (CDK/Terraform), the rest by this compliance stack
  - GCP VPC flow logs configured via VpcFlowLogsConfig resources with
  retention sinks

  Cloudflare Zero Trust (ZTNA):
  - Tunnel connectors running as ECS Fargate tasks inside private
  subnets
  - AcmeDev: 2 active connectors (acme-staging-eu in eu-central-1,
  acme-staging-us in us-east-1) — desiredCount: 1 each
  - AcmeProd: 2 active connectors (acme-production-eu,
  acme-production-us) — desiredCount: 1 each
  - GlobexProd: 2 connectors defined but disabled (desiredCount: 0) —
   globex-prod-euc1-fargate and globex-prod-euw1-services, with
  custom tunnel names
  - Each connector has a dedicated security group
  - Not enabled on GlobexDev, AcmeTest, GlobexSecurity, or
  Management

  Security Monitoring:
  - GuardDuty: Org-wide, administered from GlobexSecurity account,
  findings exported to S3 for long-term archival
  - SCC (GCP): NotificationConfigs on both GCP projects, pushing
  HIGH/CRITICAL findings → Pub/Sub → Cloud Function → Slack
  (#ops_alerts_security)
  - CloudWatch log retention: Tiered enforcement (365d security, 90d
  default, 14d ephemeral) across all ~4000 log groups in 8 accounts
  - Slack notifications: CW alarms fan-in via SQS → Lambda → Slack,
  per-account alarm channels plus a shared security channel
  (C0EXAMPLE1A)
